content.short: Openfort is an open-source wallet-as-a-service platform offering embedded (in-app) and cross-app wallets.
content.description: Openfort delivers wallet-as-a-service with both embedded (in-app) and global (cross-app) wallets. It consolidates authentication, account abstraction, gas sponsorship, and orchestration, so teams can avoid juggling multiple vendors. Supported chains include Ethereum, Arbitrum, Avalanche, Base, Tron, Polygon, OP Mainnet, Polkadot, BNB Chain, Celo, Harmony, and Bitcoin, with enterprise-focused readiness for scalable deployments across organizations.
